# Okjökull

**Okjökull** (Icelandic pronunciation: \[ˈɔkˌjœːkʏtl̥], **Ok glacier**) was a glacier in western Iceland on top of the shield volcano Ok.

**Okjökull**

- **Type:** Glacier
- **Location:** Iceland
- **Coordinates:** 64.598°N 20.881°W
- **Thickness:** less than 50 m (160 ft)
- **Status:** Former glacier

Ok is located north-east of Reykjavík. The glacier was declared dead in 2014 by glaciologist Oddur Sigurðsson by reason of its lack of the thickness. By 2017 it was less than the 2015 area of 0.7 km2 (0.27 sq mi).
